name: MCT Excellence IQ
description: An AI-powered Instructional Intelligence Skill that helps Microsoft Certified Trainers design, deliver, assess, localize, and continuously improve world-class Microsoft learning experiences across Azure, Business Applications, Data & AI, Modern Work, and Security.
author: Faride Ilanda
coverImageAlt: A faceted teaching prism connects four blank learning stations in a continuous improvement loop.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a learning experience is shaped through a complete cycle of discovery, hands-on practice, assessment, feedback, and improvement, represented as one coherent instructional instrument
Scene/backdrop: an uncluttered warm-paper learning studio field with one compact slate platform and no classroom scenery
Subject: one central faceted teaching prism joined to four distinct tactile learning stations by one smooth continuous cyan light ribbon that loops back into the prism, with one restrained orange practice station
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered slightly top-down view at a compact scale; contain the complete prism, uninterrupted loop, all stations, platform, and shadows within the central 68% of the canvas; leave at least 16% calm empty border on every side; no object may enter the outer 12%
Lighting/mood: inclusive, rigorous, encouraging, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: the light ribbon must have smooth rounded ends and no direction markers; no arrows, arrowheads, chevrons, flowchart connectors, people, graduation caps, product marks, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, flags, icons, diagrams, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding; every station blank and unmarked
